defect: EPSILON_CCI uses were reformatted.
reason: The blamed lines are only reformatted by the type/style fix #713.

reason: This change added the mandatory component read on line 120. The fix makes unknown and component optional with null checks.

defect: The density basis is built from m_mapping and refined until its size reaches the element count, and the thresholding assigns Maxvalue; the element-to-coefficient mapping may be wrong.
reason: The fix rebuilds the degree-0 basis from n_basis with element marking. This research code was also rewritten in between, so it is unclear whether the blamed lines gave wrong results.

defect: Coarsening only the underlying base basis of the mapped basis (marked TODO) gives inconsistent transfer matrices.
reason: The fix adds a projection-based approach as a feature. The change itself flagged the line as incomplete.

defect: An info message string was changed.
reason: Line 565 is a gsInfo message that is only touched incidentally by the later rewrite.

defect: The surface-case weight is multiplied by sqrt(det G).
reason: The fix comments the scaling out in a debugging series; mathematically sqrt(det G) is the surface measure. It is unclear that this was a defect.

defect: w_ is rebuilt at every quadrature point, and the standard quadrature is used.
reason: The fix hoists w_ out of the loop (efficiency), adds subdivided quadrature (feature) and re-parenthesises an equivalent expression.

defect: Including <unistd.h> unconditionally breaks the build on MSVC/Windows, which has no unistd.h.
reason: This change added the include on line 28, and the fix immediately removes it.

defect: The L2 projection integrates with the coarse basis, but the fine function needs the fine basis for exact integration.
reason: This change added the projectFunction call on line 79, and the fix switches it to the overload with the fine integration basis. Spotting this needs gsL2Projection's contract.

defect: The theta scheme subtracts Dt*(1-theta)*m_matrix*curSolution (mass matrix) instead of the stiffness matrix.
reason: The file is new in this change, and the fix replaces m_matrix with m_stiffMat in that term.

defect: The coarsening_direct and coarsening_direct2 function names were swapped.
reason: This change only reformatted the signature on line 1331 and added an assert. The name swap was made later.

defect: m_lambda is built from lambda with length m, which the fix changes to n.
reason: In IPOPT's finalize_solution, lambda holds the m constraint multipliers, so length m looks correct. The 'fix' is questionable rather than repairing a clear defect.

defect: Braced one-line if statements in segmentFromTo.
reason: The fix #713 only reformats lines 104-105.

defect: The asserts reference m_mat instead of m_expr.
reason: The fix renames the member throughout, including lines this change did not touch, following a member rename. This change only relaxed the asserts.

defect: return EXIT_SUCCESS at the end of main.
reason: The later fix rewrites the example in general. Nothing is wrong on line 202.

defect: The example used the assembler constructor and initialize overloads available at the time.
reason: The fix, 66 days later, adapts the example to a later assembler API change.

defect: The new localToGlobal ignores its eliminatedDofs argument when pushing the mass matrix, so contributions from eliminated (Dirichlet) dofs are lost.
reason: This change added localToGlobal, and the fix passes eliminatedDofs[0] to pushToMatrix ('gsVisitorMass: bug fix, eliminated dofs'). Seeing it needs the gsSparseSystem push API.

defect: The assembled bilinear form was changed to E_m_der.tr()*E_m_der, which has the wrong orientation for the test x trial form.
reason: The fix rewrites the assembly as meas(G)*(N_der*E_m_der.tr() + M_der*E_f_der.tr()) with an RHS. In this debugging commit it is unclear whether the flip alone was the error.

defect: Handles stored in mxUINT64_CLASS arrays are accessed with mxGetInt64s, which returns NULL for a uint64 array under the typed-data API, so the handle read or write dereferences a null pointer.
reason: The change replaced mxGetData with mxGetInt64s on lines 87/95/106, and the fix replaces them with mxGetUint64s. The array is created as mxUINT64_CLASS a few lines above, so the mismatch shows in the diff.

defect: The core gsForwardDeclarations.h now includes the optional gsHLBFGS/gsHLBFGS.h before the gismo namespace exists, which risks a circular include or compile failure when HLBFGS is enabled.
reason: The change added the include and the fix removes it two days later in an unrelated 'mesh file I/O' commit. The concrete failure is not documented.

defect: Checks on the input-file object counts used GISMO_ASSERT, which is compiled out in release builds.
reason: The fix only upgrades the asserts to GISMO_ENSURE. That is hardening of the check level, not a wrong result for valid input.

defect: markTagged push_backs indices unsorted and possibly duplicated, but is_tagged_index uses std::binary_search on m_tagged, so tagged lookups give wrong answers.
reason: The change added markTagged with push_back (line 170), and the fix replaces it with a sorted unique insert. The binary_search requirement sits in gsDofMapper.h.

defect: The header API of the work-in-progress builder was redesigned the next day.
reason: The fix rewrites the method signatures and members (refactor and redesign). It does not repair a defect in the blamed declarations.

defect: The comparator is declared as 'static struct _compTriplet {...} compTriplet;', a static data member that is never defined, so ODR-use in addSorted fails to link or compile (MSVC).
reason: The change added the static member on line 59, and the fix ('fix attempt for ms') removes the static.

defect: The outer-normal branch tests tarDim==domDim+1 (the surface case) instead of tarDim==domDim, so boundary outer normals are computed in the wrong case.
reason: The change replaced the parent's 'tarDim==domDim && d==n' with 'tarDim==domDim+1' on line 282, and the fix restores tarDim==domDim.

defect: gsSpectraGenSymShiftSolver accepts a GEigsMode parameter, but SpectraShiftOps always builds B as the B-matrix product, so Buckling mode, which needs A as the B operator, gives wrong eigenvalues.
reason: The new shift-solver classes are the blamed lines. The fix adds a Buckling specialization with opB(A) and passes GEigsMode through, and the Buckling requirement comes from the Spectra library.

defect: The loops compare an index_t against m_ops.size() (signed/size_t mixing).
reason: The fix only juggles size_t and index_t types to silence warnings. Behaviour is unchanged.

defect: fupn_eval_single evaluates the unmodified Fup function.
reason: A later fix in this work-in-progress extension adds boundary-modified basis functions (mod_coeff) and renames the helper. That is feature evolution, not a defect in this change.

defect: The newly enabled assertion used==0||used==sz fails on valid configurations (dG with edge primal dofs in 3D).
reason: The change turned a TODO-commented assertion into an active one (line 257), and the fix comments it out because it fires wrongly. Only running such a case shows it.

defect: gsAsVector/gsAsConstVector derive from gsAsMatrix<T,_Rows,(_Rows==1?1:0)>, which gives a fixed 0-column map for any _Rows other than 1 (including Dynamic) instead of a column vector.
reason: The change introduced the (_Rows==1?1:0) column parameter on lines 230/234/274/279, and the fix the same day changes it to 1.

defect: The HLBFGS include and solver case are guarded by GISMO_WITH_HLBFGS, a macro the build never defines, so the HLBFGS option is silently compiled out.

defect: moveToPtr allocates new gsMatrix<T> rather than the actual class type (for example RowMajor or fixed size).
reason: The parent already had 'new gsMatrix<T>'; this change only switched uPtr to Ptr. The defect predates the change.

defect: A debug message prints sym.m_fs instead of the symbol.
reason: The fix only changes the text of a gsDebug message.

defect: abs_expr::eval now returns eval_impl(...).norm(), which calls .norm() on a Scalar for scalar-valued expressions (compile error) and turns elementwise abs of matrices into a norm.
reason: The change added .norm() on line 2707, and the fix reverts to returning eval_impl with AutoReturn_t. Both eval_impl overloads are visible in the same class.

defect: gsIpOpt declares its own numIterations and finalObjective, which solve() fills, while the base getters iterations() and objective() return the never-set m_numIterations and m_finalObjective.
reason: This new file added the shadowing members (lines 118-119), and the fix removes them and has the .hpp write the base members. Seeing the bug needs gsIpOpt.hpp and gsOptimizer.h.

defect: active_into writes each block at row offset 'shift' (the cumulative basis size) instead of the cumulative number of active rows, so it writes out of bounds or into the wrong rows.
reason: The change added result.block(shift, ...) on line 168, and the fix introduces shift_rows. The u.cols()==1 assert on line 148 was also relaxed.

defect: The residual estimator is scaled by the parametric element volume (product of side lengths, h^d) instead of h^2 of the physical element diameter.
reason: The change added hh as the product of parametric extents and 'return hh*sum', and the fix computes the physical diameter and returns hh*hh*sum.

defect: The normal variation uses outNormals and a misplaced division by the measure.
reason: The outNormals use was already in the parent; this change only added a comment on line 114. Line 334 is the geometry setup in an example still in progress.

defect: toSparseMatrix_into was rewritten with triplets and debug out-of-bounds printing.
reason: The triplet version gives the same matrix; the fix reverts this intermediate debug rewrite to insert/makeCompressed together with an index-type template change.

defect: Template-parameter refactor of component and knot accessors and k_refine.
reason: The fix is a refactor plus new refine_k/p/h API (Self_t:: qualification). No wrong result in the blamed lines is repaired.

defect: The L2 projection in the coarsening check used the coarse integration basis.
reason: The only blamed line is the gsMultiPatch declaration, touched incidentally; the fix is debugging work on an example.

defect: A changed method signature in the work-in-progress builder header.
reason: The later commit changes the API again (redesign), not a defect fix.

defect: The example used 5 sample points and returned early.
reason: The fix changes the debugging parameters of an example (15 points, removes the early return). That is a change of mind.

defect: The in-class declarations 'virtual gsBasis::uPtr create()' and 'tensorize()' lack typename.
reason: The fix adds typename to the lines this change added. Inside the class template, uPtr names a member of the current instantiation, so typename is optional by the standard, and it is unclear which supported compiler failed.

defect: BSplineHyperCube lifts a cube centred at (x,y,z) from 0 to t in the fourth coordinate, so the result is not a hypercube of side r centred at (x,y,z,t).
reason: The new function on line 380 is replaced by the fix with a symmetric lift of r/2 plus translation. lift4D's behaviour is visible in the same file.

defect: In cc_acc3, c11 is assigned with '=' right after 'c10 = c01 = c11 = n*points[v]', dropping the n*points[v] term that the old code kept with '+='.
reason: The change moved the c11 computation and turned += into = (lines 2038-2041), and the fix restores 'c11 += ...' after the initialization.

defect: splitAt calls insertKnot with p+1-mult without guarding mult==p+1.
reason: The parent had the same expression; this change only replaced copy-> with copy. The defect predates the change.

defect: The L2 Monge-Ampere residual diagnostic formula.
reason: The blamed line is a diagnostic that the later large redesign removes. No specific defect repair is tied to it.

defect: The uniform sample grid uses i/n, so the parameters never reach the boundary value 1.

defect: The gsMapData constructor dropped the side member.
reason: The fix adds the side, outNormals and jacobians fields as a feature. The blamed line (Base(_flags)) is touched only incidentally.

defect: Unused test space and coefficient variables in the example.

defect: An empty public section holding commented-out code.

defect: Composition projection setup in the builder.
reason: The later commit is a broad redesign of the work-in-progress class, not a fix of these lines.

defect: Debugging code for the L2 projection solved a multi-column rhs into a gsVector.
reason: Both commits are work-in-progress debugging iterations, and the fix's message calls itself WIP. It is not a clear repair of a defect in this change.

defect: The default input file path of the example.

defect: The Spectra include paths do not match the bundled Spectra layout and include directories.

defect: Multipatch JSON reading builds geometries inline with std::make_unique.
reason: The fix refactors the geometry reading into get_Geometry and adds assertions. No concrete wrong behaviour of the blamed lines is repaired.

defect: Added geometry cases 11-13 in the example.

defect: Code style of toBezier.
reason: The blamed line is only reformatted by the fix (braces and indentation).

defect: Example case list and degree settings.
reason: The fix removes and renumbers example cases. That is a change of mind.

defect: Debug output 'Finished' in the example.

defect: Free functions and __PRETTY_FUNCTION__ do not build on Visual Studio.

defect: An MSVC C4996 workaround with stdext::unchecked_array_iterator.
reason: The fix is an upstream exprtk update that simplifies a warning workaround. Not a defect.

defect: The bound check reads m_gamma[n-1], one past the end of the off-diagonal (size n-1), while the next line uses m_gamma[n-2].
reason: The commit added line 230 with m_gamma[n-1]. The fix changes it to m_gamma[n-2], which is the out-of-bounds fix its message names.

defect: The density is built with buildDensity(elwise, 0.1) without the extra arguments; the later fix replaces this with marked-element density construction.
reason: The change only dropped arguments to match an API change. The fix redesigns how the density is built (marking strategy, new buildDensity overload), so it is unclear that the dropped arguments were the bug.

defect: The failure count from RunTestsIf is stored in a bool.
reason: Storing the count in a bool still yields a nonzero exit code on failure. Changing bool to int is a type or warning cleanup, not a wrong result.

defect: The fix removes the setBasis helper the change added.
reason: setBasis deletes the owned basis and stores the new one, which is correct. Removing it is cleanup, not a defect repair.

defect: The change switches debug prints of Fint_m/Fint_f from gsDebug to gsInfo.
reason: The blamed lines are output statements that the fix's rewrite of the example touches only incidentally. The real fixes (transposes) are elsewhere.

defect: The new copy constructor and assignment clone faces and copy edges, but their vertex pointers still point to the source mesh's vertices, giving dangling or aliased pointers.
reason: The commit added the copy constructor. The fix rewires face and edge vertex pointers to the cloned vertices. Seeing this needs gsFace/gsEdge's pointer members.

defect: The change leaves gsDebugVar prints in uniformCoarsen.
reason: The fix only deletes debug output on the blamed lines.

defect: The work-in-progress example drops the last coordinate column of the curve coefficients (marked 'THIS IS VERY WRONG'), fills the boundary containers with whole patches instead of boundary curves, and uses the wrong points for the parametrization.
reason: The commit added these lines. The fix removes the conservativeResize, uses boundary(0), and rebuilds pts as a parametric grid.

defect: evalAllDersSingle_into passes the same udata pointer for every column k, so every point is evaluated at u(0,0).
reason: The commit added the loop with an unshifted udata. The fix passes u.data()+k.

defect: The fix removes hasLabel because a later merge brought in a second hasLabel definition.
reason: The duplicate came from later commits (c74cda85a, merge c3a758260). The hasLabel the change added was correct on its own.

defect: boundaryOffset is called with boxSide(side_id) instead of bside.
reason: side_id = bside.index(), so boxSide(side_id) equals bside and the replacement is cosmetic. The fix's other change, commenting out the offset==1 block, is a change of mind.

defect: The loop conditions 'k = 0; m_points.cols(); k++' and 'u.cols()' never terminate, and a trailing comma in the initializer list breaks compilation.
reason: The commit created the file. The fix adds the k != cols() conditions and removes the trailing comma.

defect: The dependent type gsMatrix<T>::uPtr is used without 'typename' in the return statement, a compile error on conforming compilers.
reason: The commit added 'return gsMatrix<T>::uPtr(res);'. The fix adds typename.

defect: The change leaves gsDebugVar output in _makeUnique.
reason: In this file the fix only removes debug prints on the blamed lines.

defect: The fix changes the declaration return types from void to bool.
reason: This is an API and refactor change, not a repair of a defect in the added declarations.

defect: The assertion message 'Matrix must be square!' carries no dimensions.
reason: The fix only extends the assert message.

defect: f1ders is transposed in place and then resized back to (rows x cols), which scrambles the gradient data before transformDeriv2Hgrad.
reason: The commit added the transposeInPlace line in the new file. The fix deletes it. Seeing the problem needs deriv_into's output layout.

defect: The static_cast signature for addCornerValue no longer matches the method.
reason: At this commit the cast matched (boundary::corner, T, int, short_t). The signature gained a component argument later (5c32b4e83), so the fix adapts to a later change.

defect: solveDetailed returned early without filling error_history.
reason: The fix repairs solveDetailed as written in r8083, a later commit. The blamed solve() lines of this change behave correctly.

defect: The control-net collection at EVs lacks a transpose.
reason: The blamed line is only the vector declaration, which the fix renames. The fix's transpose and restructuring belong to the later rewrite.

defect: frprod_expr::eval assumes square blocks (rb = A.rows()).
reason: The parent already assumed square blocks via _u.rows(). The fix generalizes to non-square blocks with cardinality, which is not a regression from this change.

defect: The MSVC isnan/isfinite use an undeclared variable x, isnan returns x==x (inverted), and isfinite has no return statement.
reason: The commit added these bodies (lines 93, 97). The fix rewrites the blamed MSVC and mpq math helpers.

defect: The return dereferences the uPtr from makeMatrix.
reason: Dereferencing the unique_ptr and copying is correct (the change fixed a leak). The fix only adapts to makeMatrix's new return type.

defect: The per-step Paraview output in the example loop.
reason: The fix's rewrite of the example only incidentally touches the blamed output line.

defect: reshape_expr asserts on rows()*cols() in the constructor, where they are not yet known, and eval returns a gsAsMatrix view of a temporary _u.eval(k).
reason: The commit added reshape_expr. The fix moves the assertion into eval, stores the evaluation in a member tmp and returns a const view of it.

defect: fupn_eval_single is renamed.
reason: The blamed line is the function signature, which the fix only renames and cleans up.

defect: nruns is a scalar, and the sizesmax formulas are kept.
reason: The fix turns nruns into a sequence and adds factors, which is a feature. The formula style was already in the parent.

defect: readOffFile now requires nedges edge lines and returns false when an OFF file lists none, though edges are optional in OFF.
reason: The commit added the edges loop with 'return false'. The fix breaks out instead and records the actual count.

defect: gsDirichletValuesByInterpolation assigns to a const boundary matrix, has a wrong condition 'com!=-1 || r!=com', and mixes fixedDofs[com] and fixedDofs(com), so it cannot compile or work.
reason: The commit added the whole file. The fix rewrites these lines (non-const boundary, fixedDofs handling).

defect: m_underlying is used as a reference member.
reason: In this file the fix adapts to m_underlying becoming a pointer in the header (a design change) and pre-sizes p. The .hpp code was consistent with its header.

defect: Brace placement style.
reason: The fix only reformats braces on the blamed line.

defect: The default maxIterations is 5000.
reason: The fix raises a parameter default, a change of mind.

defect: The change re-encoded the file ('fix chars').
reason: The blamed lines are touched only through re-encoding. The fix adds Wolfe-Powell features and parameter changes.

defect: The errest computation line in the DWR example.
reason: The fix comes 140 days later in a large rewrite and touches this line only incidentally. No defect from this change is shown.

defect: nodeSearch is const only, so visitors cannot modify nodes.
reason: The fix adds non-const overloads so visitors can change index levels, which is a feature.

defect: The default input file is pde/example3D.xml.
reason: The fix switches the example's input file and degree, a change of mind.

defect: The new collocationMatrix and collocationMatrixWithDeriv call result.reserve(nact) with per-row counts of length u.cols(), but the column-major sparse matrix needs per-column counts of length size(), giving wrong or out-of-bounds allocation.
reason: The commit added these functions. The fix makes nact sized this->size() and counts per column, 'fixed memory allocation'.

defect: The knot vectors kv1/kv2 are swapped in SetKnot.
reason: The change only turned int loop indices into size_t. The swap was already in the parent.

defect: The default input path is changed to domain2d/two_patches_from_gluing_data.xml, which does not exist in filedata, so the example fails with defaults.
reason: The commit changed line 6 to the missing file. The fix 'fix pathes' points it to an existing file.

defect: jacobian() indexes values[1].coeffRef(point, func*derivSize) with row and column swapped (points are columns), and is not const.
reason: The commit added jacobian. The fix swaps to coeffRef(func*derivSize, point) and makes it const. The neighbouring accessors use point as the column.

defect: Boundary-edge test code in the example.
reason: The fix comments the blamed lines out while switching the example to vertex testing, a change of mind.

defect: An empty parametrizeBack stub.
reason: The fix only removes the empty stub.

defect: The added operator=(const unique_ptr&) calls this->operator= with a unique_ptr&, which picks itself again (infinite recursion), and it returns an auto_ptr& as unique_ptr&.
reason: The commit added lines 100-101. The fix replaces them with operator= overloads taking const auto_ptr<U>/auto_ptr<T>.

defect: The error indicator uses the parametric div(istress) instead of the physical idiv(istress,PP).
reason: The commit replaced idiv(istress,PP) with div(istress). The next-day fix 'bug in rh_time' restores idiv.

defect: exH.initSystem() is called redundantly after the projections.
reason: The fix only removes the duplicate initSystem the change moved. No wrong result is repaired.

defect: The density and refinement setup of the time-dependent example.
reason: The fix, 150 days later, redesigns the density construction. The blamed lines are touched only incidentally.

defect: getTempPath calls free() on the pointer returned by getenv(), which the program does not own, so memory gets corrupted.
reason: The new file adds free(_temp) right after _temp = getenv(...); the fix comments out those free calls ('Fixed memory corruption').

defect: onormal_expr::rowSpan/colSpan were changed to GISMO_ERROR and rowVar/colVar were removed, so any expression using nv() fails at run time or does not compile.
reason: The change replaced the working rowVar/colVar and rowSpan(){return false;} with GISMO_ERROR stubs; the fix 0.2 days later restores them.

defect: No defect: the fix only follows a later change of makeMatrix's return type from uPtr to gsMatrix.
reason: At this commit makeMatrix returned a uPtr, so *(makeMatrix(...)) was correct and fixed the earlier .release() leak; the later edit is an API follow-up.

defect: The copy constructor calls reserve() and then cloneAll into m_bases.begin() of an empty vector, which writes past the end (undefined behaviour).
reason: The change replaced the push_back loop with reserve + cloneAll(begin()); the fix changes reserve to resize.

defect: No defect in the blamed line: the fix only reformats the isEnd brace style.

defect: Only the debug Paraview plotting code changes which patch and basis it writes.
reason: The blamed line is a plotting gsField used for visualization; the fix changes what gets plotted, which is a change of mind about debug output.

defect: The fix only adds a '// TODO' comment to the blamed line.
reason: The fix hunk for the blamed line changes only a comment; the code is unchanged.

defect: Only the example's default plot flag is changed.
reason: The fix sets plot back to true and changes the input file; these are example settings, not a defect.

defect: The switch cast changes from int to unsigned int to silence warnings.
reason: Casting the enum to int or to unsigned int in the switch gives the same behaviour; this is a warning fix.

defect: The fix adds a 'parametric' option and removes debug output.
reason: The fix adds a new constructor parameter and a branch, and drops gsDebugVar lines; this is feature work, not a repair of a wrong result in the blamed lines.

defect: The blamed line is a diagnostic 'Primal error' print that the fix removes.
reason: The fix's real changes (transposes) are elsewhere; at the blamed line it only deletes an output statement.

defect: A leftover 'return 0;' inside the est==1 branch ends the program before the marking and refinement code, so function-wise refinement never runs.

defect: exportTHBsurface sets the trimming-curve interval directly to the surface parameters (y1,y2 / x1,x2) instead of the isoparametric curve's own parameter range, so the trimming is wrong.

defect: The fix only deletes a commented-out function.
reason: The blamed lines are a /* */ commented block that the fix removes; no code changes.

defect: In the 180-degree rotation, the loop runs to i < dimU*dimV-1, so the last coefficient row of mpar is never filled.

reason: The gsGetReal call in gsXml.hpp predates this change, which only moved gsGetInt and added a commented-out gsGetValue block. The fix enables that block, a pre-existing limitation.

defect: The uncommented loop assigns a 1x1 beta expression into cond.col(i), where cond has FR.targetDim() rows, a size mismatch.
reason: The fix changes cond to 1 row but also swaps to the other (vector-valued) formula. This looks like research back-and-forth rather than a clean repair of the activated line.

defect: setConstant is called with its arguments in the wrong order (value first), so the matrix size and the value are swapped.
reason: The parent already had result.setConstant(m_val, u.cols()), which was wrong too. The change turned it into another wrong form (m_val,1,cols), so the defect predates the change.

defect: gsKroneckerProduct inherits privately from gsLinearOperator.
reason: The parent already had 'class gsKroneckerProduct : gsLinearOperator'. The change only added GISMO_EXPORT.

defect: Debug prints and an exploratory condition loop were left active.
reason: The fix just comments out the debug output and the loop. That is a debug/style cleanup, not a defect repair.

defect: gsWriteParaviewPoints writes a .vtp PolyData file but creates the .pvd collection referencing '.vts', so the collection points to a nonexistent file.
reason: This change added makeCollection(fn, ".vts") after code that appends ".vtp" to the file name. The fix changes it to ".vtp".

defect: A debug a1.print(gsInfo) was left in _parse, which prints every parsed expression.
reason: The fix only comments out a stray debug print: an output/style cleanup, not a correctness defect.

defect: The example's edge loop and test geometry were changed during research.
reason: The fix ('Fixed parametrization back') swaps the commented and active experimental blocks in an example. That is a change of mind, not a defect repair.

defect: pointSet was changed from QVector to QList, but axlMesh::setVertices expects a QVector, which breaks the Axel plugin build.
reason: This change replaced QVector with QList, and 22 minutes later the fix reverts it ('fixing previous change'). The mismatch needs the axlMesh API to see.

defect: An optional module header (gsHLBFGS.h) was included at the top of the core forward-declarations header, which risks circular includes or compile failures when gsHLBFGS is enabled.
reason: The fix removes exactly the three added include lines two days later without explanation. Whether it actually broke compilation cannot be confirmed from the code.

defect: var1 used outNormals instead of the surface normal and divided by the measure in the wrong place.
reason: The outNormals usage predates this change, which only added a comment on line 114. Line 334 (the BSplineSquare test patch) is touched only incidentally.

defect: The new allocation assertion compares m_matrix.cols() with m_rhs.size(), which fails falsely for a right-hand side with several columns.
reason: This change replaced '0 != m_rhs.size()' with 'm_matrix.cols() == m_rhs.size()' and added it in several push methods. The fix changes size() to rows().

defect: The new argMin initial-guess grid uses 5 points per direction.
reason: The fix raises the sampling from 5 to 20 points per direction. That is parameter tuning, not a defect in the logic.

defect: Debug prints and a commented-out output block were left in the example.
reason: In this file the fix only removes the gsDebugVar lines and uncomments the final prints. The real 'current design' fix is in gsHLBFGS.h.

defect: insertKnot was ambiguous between gsBSpline and gsGeometry.
reason: This change correctly made the second call consistent with the first (copy.gsBSpline<T>::insertKnot). The fix is an API redesign adding a dir parameter.

defect: The closestPointTo tolerance was set to 1e-2.
reason: The fix tightens the tolerance from 1e-2 to 1e-6 while mainly fixing orient_faces (an unrelated copy bug). That is tuning or a change of mind on the tolerance.

defect: The constructor branch for nrhs==2 reads prhs[2] (out of bounds) and builds gsKnotVector from *knots (a single double) instead of the knot array.
reason: This change added the new file with mxGetDoubles(prhs[2]) inside 'if (nrhs==2)' and new gsKnotVector<T>(*knots). The fix uses prhs[2] with nrhs==3 and builds a std::vector of the knots.

defect: A debug print of the beta matrix was enabled.
reason: Blamed line 278 is a gsInfo debug print that the fix comments out. That is not a correctness defect.

defect: The research example switched its geometry file and its interface/vertex loops.
reason: The fix switches the geometry file/id back and comments out the vertex loop. That is experimental churn, not a defect repair.

defect: The code calls the nonexistent pybind11_enum_gsBiharmonicExprAssembler instead of pybind11_init_gsBiharmonicExprAssembler, which breaks the pybind build.
reason: This change added the call. The header added in the same commit declares only pybind11_init_..., and the fix renames the call.

defect: Only a print label ('error in pt2' -> 'pt1') was changed.
reason: Blamed line 286 is a label edit. The fix rewrites the surrounding experimental composition code, so the line is touched only incidentally.

defect: sprintf into a 6-byte buffer of an unsigned short.
reason: The value is at most 65535 (5 digits plus NUL), so no overflow is possible. The fix replaces sprintf with snprintf to silence a deprecation warning.

defect: The new composition operator() assigns to a const gsMultiPatch member through 'this.' in a const method and returns 'this' (a pointer) as an object, so it cannot compile, and a const by-value member makes gsGeometryMap non-assignable.
reason: This change added the const gsMultiPatch m_composedMap member and the broken operator(). The fix turns the member into a pointer and rewrites operator() to set it via const_cast and return *this.

defect: A mass (L2) term was added to the biharmonic stiffness matrix in the branch where L2approx is false, so the wrong operator is assembled for an unchanged right-hand side.
reason: This change added localMat += weight*L2approximation. The fix ('Fix') comments out exactly that line.

defect: The gsExprAssembler forward declaration was reduced to a single template parameter.
reason: The change is consistent with gsExprAssembler.h in the same commit. The fix adds _Options/_Index parameters for a new row-major and index feature.

defect: ensureCounterclockwise now reverses the points when they are already counterclockwise (the condition is inverted).
reason: The parent had '!isCounterclockwise(...)'. This change made it 'isCounterclockwise(...)>0', and the fix restores the negation.

defect: The example added a diffusion assembly test that printed the dense matrix.
reason: The fix restructures the example to add matrix-free solving, a feature. The blamed line is touched only incidentally.

defect: The new merge assumes split nodes at matching positions have identical axis/pos (and leaves identical boxes), so trees with different split structure merge incorrectly or trip the identical-box assertion.
reason: This change added merge(), whose case 3 pairs left with left and right with right without checking the splits, and whose case 4 asserts equal boxes. The fix adds split-mismatch handling and box intersection.

defect: gsFeVariable::rows() now returns m_fs->targetDim() instead of m_d times the number of actives or values.
reason: The change deliberately switched to targetDim ('not needed since cardinality implementation'). The fix's author reverted it because his code needed it, so this may be a design disagreement rather than a defect.

defect: Research churn in the adaptive builder's method declarations.
reason: The fix rearranges and adds method declarations (buildHBMultiPatch, buildCompMultiPatch defaults). That is a feature/refactor, not a defect repair.

defect: The constructors initialize the base as gsVector<T,2> and gsVector<T,3>, although the base class is gsVector<T,dim>, which is ill-formed and breaks the build on other compilers.
reason: This change replaced gsVector<T,dim> with fixed 2/3 in the mem-initializers. The fix ('fix xcode and vs?') restores gsVector<T,d>.

defect: insertKnot uses this->m_basis.weights() on a gsBasis pointer, which does not compile.
reason: The parent's version (this->m_weights, tbs.m_weights) was already non-compiling. This change rewrote it into another broken form, and the fix uses weights().

defect: For valuesNormals corner conditions the mapper eliminates corner dofs 0..4 instead of all six except index 3, so it fixes the wrong second-derivative dof.
reason: This change added the corner elimination loop 'for j<5'. The fix changes it to 'j<6, j!=3'. Knowing the corner dof ordering requires the basis layout.

defect: In the two-patch case the beta right-hand side subtracts the lambda0/lambda1 alpha correction.
reason: The fix ('fix the kink'), 73 days later, comments out the two-patch correction. It is unclear whether this repairs a mathematical error or is a change of approach.

defect: The debug check in operator* refers to the nonexistent member m_upos (it lives in m_uit), which fails to compile in debug/secure-STL builds.
reason: This change replaced m_pos with m_upos in the GISMO_ENSURE. The fix, a minute later, reverts it to m_pos.

defect: getMeshVertexIDsFromPositions now only logs a missing coordinate or out_of_range and leaves IDs(k) uninitialized instead of failing.
reason: This change replaced the asserting lookup with try/catch and cerr logging. The fix restores map.at / GISMO_ASSERT so that unregistered points are not silently given garbage IDs.
